decals.prompt:
Use case: text-localization / transparent game texture decal.
Create a standalone replacement marking extracted from the style of the supplied Sai spacecraft texture. The input is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: do NOT copy its malformed or mirrored text, background, panels or seams.

Output a transparent PNG containing exactly the Japanese characters "侍飛将".
Layout: ONE vertical column, exactly THREE full-size kanji, upright and normally readable, top-to-bottom:
侍
飛
将
Use precisely these Japanese forms. First character 侍 U+4F8D has the person radical 亻 on left and 寺 on right. Second is 飛 U+98DB, not simplified 飞. Third is 将 U+5C06, not traditional 將. Accuracy of each stroke and radical is the highest priority. No mirrored or reversed characters.

Style: match the original thick, compact, hand-painted military marking: bold upright Japanese brush lettering in dark vermilion / muted brick red, close to #a42720. Modestly irregular brush edges and a few tiny transparent paint chips, fine restrained pigment variation. Mostly solid strokes, crisp readable internal spaces. Not cursive, not wildly expressive, not a generic sans-serif typeface. Deliberately clean enough to serve as the new high-resolution master decal; the hull's wear will be added separately.

Composition: frontal flat 2D orthographic marking, no perspective or skew. Portrait canvas, all three characters equal visual scale, evenly spaced, with comfortable transparent margins around all sides and clear transparent gaps between characters.
Only the red paint should be visible. Genuine alpha transparency throughout the entire background and inside all glyph counters and chips. No hull, metal, paper, checkerboard, white rectangle, backplate, shadows, outline, embossing, lighting, border, seals, captions or extra marks. Do not place the marking on an object.

Use case: text-localization / transparent game texture decal.
Create a standalone replacement marking in the hand-painted style of the supplied Sai spacecraft texture. The input is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Replace the malformed/obscured writing with an accurate complete marking; do not reproduce the hull, red sun/rays, seams, fixtures or background.

Output a transparent PNG containing exactly the Japanese characters "神風".
Layout: ONE horizontal row, exactly TWO full-size kanji, upright and normally readable from left to right:
神 風
The left character is 神 U+795E (left component 礻 and right component 申, preserving their complete legible structures). The right character is 風 U+98A8, the full Japanese form with its internal 虫 component, not simplified 风. Preserve all defining strokes and open counters. Accuracy of the characters is the highest priority. No mirror reversal, no extra characters, no swapped order.

Style: match thick, compact Japanese brush lettering originally painted on the ship, in deep charcoal black close to #171916. Modest organic brush edges, restrained dry-brush variation, a few tiny transparent paint chips. Mostly solid bold strokes with clear internal spaces. Avoid extremely cursive or sprawling calligraphy; this is readable rugged hand-painted military hull lettering. Enough texture to feel painted, but clean enough for a high-resolution replacement decal. No metal colours or external surface texture.

Composition: flat frontal 2D orthographic marking, landscape canvas, equal visual character scale, balanced generous transparent spacing between glyphs and comfortable transparent outer margins. Isolated lettering only. All space outside the black pigment and inside glyph counters/chips must have genuine alpha transparency. No white/grey background, paper, painted rectangle, checkerboard, red rays, hull, texture panel, shadows, highlights, glow, bevel, outlines, seals, brush underlines, captions or extra ornaments.
